canonical_title: Summative Assessment Methods and Their Tools
aliases: Methods of assessment suitable for assessing competency
Assessment method and evidence gathering tool

one_line_answer.text: Summative assessment methods are used to decide whether a trainee is competent or not.

cites.quote: This type of assessment is the more formal assessment and will tell you whether your trainee is competent or not.

bangla_explanation: Summative assessment-এ ঠিক হয় trainee competent কিনা, তাই methods ঠিকমতো বেছে নিতে হয়।
পাঁচটি method: written test, oral questioning, demonstration, on the job observation, trainee portfolio।
প্রতিটি method-এর একটি evidence gathering tool আছে, যেমন portfolio-র জন্য portfolio evaluation checklist।
Oral questioning-এর জন্য questions আর model answers আগে থেকেই prepared রাখতে হয়।

example.en: A motor mechanic trainee services a car engine in the workshop. The assessor uses a task observation checklist.
example.bn: ওয়ার্কশপে demonstration-এর সময় assessor checklist দিয়ে evidence নেন।

items.text: Written Test: for "knowing" and "thinking" learning outcomes; a paper and pencil test.

cites.quote: For "knowing" and "thinking" kinds of learning outcomes the written tests or sometimes called paper and pencil test

items.text: Oral Questioning: used alone or in tandem with demonstration or on the job observation.

cites.quote: This technique can be used alone or in tandem with demonstration or on the job observation.

items.text: Demonstration: the trainee performs a task under actual or simulated conditions.

cites.quote: The trainee is asked to perform a task under actual or simulated conditions.

items.text: On the Job Observation: at the job site, using a prepared observation checklist.

cites.quote: On the Job Observation While the trainee is performing the task in the job site

items.text: Trainee Portfolio: trainees gather evidence of accomplishments during the training period.

cites.quote: trainees are responsible in gathering data or evidence of his accomplishments during the entire training period

traps.text: Portfolio uses a portfolio evaluation checklist, not a task observation checklist.
On-the-job observation is inappropriate when work activities occur irregularly.

cites.quote: On-the-job observation is inappropriate when: work activities occur irregularly

traps.text: Written tests must assess not only recall but the higher level of learning.

cites.quote: Written test must consider being able to assess not only recall but the higher level of learning

short.prompt: List the methods of assessment suitable for use when assessing competency.
short.modelAnswer:
Methods used for summative assessment:
1. Written Test: for "knowing" and "thinking" outcomes.
2. Oral Questioning: alone or with demonstration or observation.
3. Demonstration: task under actual or simulated conditions.
4. On the Job Observation: at the job site, with an observation checklist.
5. Trainee Portfolio: evidence gathered during the training period.

keyPoints.text: Oral questioning gives evidence of underpinning knowledge, task management and contingency management skills.

cites.quote: provide evidence of underpinning knowledge, application of skills, task management skills and contingency management skills

keyPoints.text: A list of questions and model answers is prepared before the assessment.

cites.quote: A list of questions and model answers is prepared before you conduct the assessment.

keyPoints.text: In a demonstration, the teacher uses a previously prepared observation guide.

cites.quote: The teacher gathers the data or evidence using a previously prepared observation guide

keyPoints.text: In a portfolio, trainees gather evidence of their accomplishments during the training period.

cites.quote: trainees are responsible in gathering data or evidence of his accomplishments during the entire training period

viva.prompt: How does formative assessment help a trainee portfolio?

answer.text: Formative assessment data can contribute to a better judgment of trainee competence.

cites.quote: Formative assessment data or evidence can contribute to a better judgment as to the competence of the trainees.

checks.note: The information sheet (p.35-36) lists 5 summative methods: Written Test, Oral Questioning, Demonstration, On the Job Observation, Trainee Portfolio. The answer key for cblm11-sc2-q1 (p.41) lists only 4, in a different order (Oral Questioning, Written Test, Demonstration, Trainee Portfolio) and omits On the Job Observation. Card follows the information sheet. Confirm whether learners should write 4 or 5.

The p.36 method-to-tool table has 6 rows; Observation and Demonstration both map to "Task observation checklist". Matching uses 5 rows to avoid a duplicate right side. The table also lists "Observation" as a method that is not one of the 5 described summative methods.
